# MewDock markup reference

Fluent extensions declared by the `Aprillz.MewUI.MewDock` package.

### DockingManager

Receiver: `DockingManager`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `CenterContent(UIElement value)` | `CenterContent` | Sets the element shown in place of the document host, which panes still dock around; null shows the document host. |
| `OnActivePaneChanged(Action<DockPane> handler)` | `event ActivePaneChanged` | Adds an active pane changed event handler. |
| `OnActivePaneChanged(EventHandler<DockPane> handler)` | `event ActivePaneChanged` | Subscribes handler to ActivePaneChanged. Occurs when ActivePane changes, with the new pane or null. |
| `OnChanged(Action handler)` | `event Changed` | Adds a changed event handler. |
| `OnChanged(EventHandler handler)` | `event Changed` | Subscribes handler to Changed. Occurs after any change to the layout (a user gesture or a handle verb), once the change is complete. |
| `OnGroupMenuOpening(Action<DockGroupMenuEventArgs> handler)` | `event GroupMenuOpening` | Adds a group menu opening event handler. |
| `OnGroupMenuOpening(EventHandler<DockGroupMenuEventArgs> handler)` | `event GroupMenuOpening` | Subscribes handler to GroupMenuOpening. Occurs each time a group's tab strip right-click menu opens, after the default items are added; handlers add application commands to Menu. |
| `OnPaneClosing(EventHandler<DockPaneClosingEventArgs> handler)` | `event PaneClosing` | Subscribes handler to PaneClosing. Occurs before the user closes a pane from the dock's own controls (a tab's close button or middle click, a caption's close button, the Close menu items); setting Cancel keeps the pane where it is. |
| `OnTabMenuOpening(Action<DockTabMenuEventArgs> handler)` | `event TabMenuOpening` | Adds a tab menu opening event handler. |
| `OnTabMenuOpening(EventHandler<DockTabMenuEventArgs> handler)` | `event TabMenuOpening` | Subscribes handler to TabMenuOpening. Occurs each time a tab's right-click menu opens, after the default items are added; handlers add application commands to Menu. |
| `WithContentFactory(Func<DockPane, UIElement> factory)` | `ContentFactory` | Sets ContentFactory and returns the manager. |
| `WithHeaderFactory(Func<DockPane, UIElement> factory)` | `HeaderFactory` | Sets HeaderFactory and returns the manager. |
